Dove la passione incontra l'opportunità Scopri il tuo viaggio nello straordinario. Il tuo scopo Il Destination Experience Manager è pienamente responsabile per le prestazioni, lo sviluppo e l'eccellenza operativa delle regioni assegnate. Questo ruolo richiede una forte esperienza di crociera sulle coste, una profonda conoscenza dei porti e della logistica di destinazione, e una solida comprensione delle operazioni a bordo. Il Manager sovrintende al ciclo di vita completo delle esperienze di destinazione, dal sourcing e dal contrarsi alla consegna a bordo e alle prestazioni finanziarie. • Scout e contrarre TOs/DMC attraverso offerte strutturate e trattative
• Assicurarsi che le esperienze siano fattibili e allineate agli standard del marchio di lusso
• Gestione dei prezzi, ROI e pianificazione delle capacità
• Superare il coordinamento dei contenuti con il Marketing e il caricamento del sistema (Seaware, Otalio, ecc.) Supporto operativo onboard &
• Assicurare che i prodotti riflettano le realtà a bordo (timing, demografie degli ospiti, considerazioni sulla mobilità)
• Treno e supporto a bordo
• Assistere con escalation, rimborsi e recupero dei servizi quando necessario
• Monitorare il feedback degli ospiti e implementare azioni correttive Gestione finanziaria e delle prestazioni
• Prestito bilancio e rendimento delle entrate per le regioni assegnate
• Monitorare i margini, le tendenze del rimborso e il contributo a livello di viaggio
• Identificare le porte sottoperformanti e ottimizzare le offerte di conseguenza
• Partner con Finance e Analytics per report e dashboard Il tuo viaggio finora - 7–10+ anni di escursioni in crociera lungo la costa, gestione della destinazione o viaggio di lusso - Corso di laurea in Ospitalità, Turismo, Business o esperienza equivalente preferito. Sei pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a Explora Journeys, dove un oceano di opportunità attende. Il vostro viaggio verso lo Stato della Mente Oceano inizia qui.

Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose The Destination Experience Manager is fully responsible for the performance, development, and operational excellence of assigned regions. This role requires strong cruise shore excursion experience, deep knowledge of ports and destination logistics, and a solid understanding of onboard operations. The Manager oversees the full lifecycle of destination experiences — from sourcing and contracting to onboard delivery and financial performance. Your Impact Destination & Product Management
• Develop and manage destination experiences across assigned regions
• Scout and contract TOs/DMCs through structured bidding and negotiation
• Ensure experiences are operationally feasible and aligned with luxury brand standards
• Manage pricing, ROI, and capacity planning
• Oversee content coordination with Marketing and system loading (Seaware, Otalio, etc.) Onboard & Operational Support
• Ensure products reflect onboard realities (timings, guest demographics, mobility considerations)
• Train and support onboard Destination teams
• Assist with escalations, refunds, and service recovery when required
• Monitor guest feedback and implement corrective actions Financial & Performance Management
• Own budgeting and revenue performance for assigned regions
• Monitor margins, refund trends, and voyage-level contribution
• Identify underperforming ports and optimize offerings accordingly
• Partner with Finance and Analytics on reporting and dashboards Your Journey so far - 7–10+ years in cruise shore excursions, destination management, or luxury travel - Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or equivalent experience preferred. Your Essentials - Strong onboard cruise experience and operational understanding - Deep knowledge of ports and destination infrastructure - Knowledge of Alaska, Caribbean, South America, or Asia regions is a strong advantage - Proven negotiation and financial management skills - Strong analytical and communication abilities - Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset - Valid Swiss work permit or eligibility to work in Switzerland / US permit for Miami position At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Your Purpose We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline. This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders. Your Impact
• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel. Your Journey so far
• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred. Your Essentials
• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. Our commitment extends to taking meaningful, measurable actions that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet. Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await. Apply today to be part of a global team that is pushing boundaries and achieving something remarkable. Your journey starts here!

Shipments

The Senior Digital Acquisition Manager will be responsible for guiding the digital marketing strategy on all MSC Cruises markets, with the aim to drive direct sales through digital advertising levers, set up and achieve KPI goals and develop innovative digital campaigns on multiple channels. The ideal candidate will have a solid experience in advertising performance and developing digital sales with a positive ROAS, as well as a strong experience in the strategy of digital advertising campaigns, planning and implementation of paid media and team leadership. In addition, the role will include the development of affiliate programs and partnerships as part of an integrated digital commitment strategy to expand the scope, drive qualified traffic and support the long-term value of the customer.

Your Impact

- Develop and maintain solid relations with MSC stakeholders in various markets, with a deep understanding of their business needs, challenges and opportunities, balancing the global goals established by the headquarters.
- Set and achieve the KPI targets for online sales through digital advertising levers, ensuring that the media agency delivers against targets and contractual obligations.
- Guide internal meetings, QBRs and annual revisions by providing strategic insights and recommendations based on campaign performance, website analysis, market trends and competitive landscape.
- Plan and implement innovative performance marketing campaigns on Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio and Video channels, tailored for business objectives and market dynamics.
- Collaboration with the internal teams, including Creative, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product and agency partners, to ensure timely delivery of high quality assets aligned with annual digital sales goals.
- Identify and pursue opportunities to improve revenue flows through existing and new digital strategies, improving the ROAS of the campaign and experiencing innovations in the adtech and martech ecosystem.
- Develop and manage lead generation strategies, ensuring that customer acquisition flows and nurturing tactics are in place on all paid media contact points.
- Monitor account resourcing and profitability to ensure that local markets and headquarters are managed efficiently and profitable.
- Main escalation point for concerns raised by internal teams or local market stakeholders.
- Continue to review and optimize operational workflows, proposing and implementing process improvements where relevant.
- Collaboration with the stakeholders of the countries and headquarters to prepare and manage the annual digital marketing budget, aligned with the B2C turnover objectives of MSC Cruises.
- Drive and optimize affiliate programs and partnerships to drive qualified traffic and conversations, ensuring alignment with digital acquisition strategy and performance goals.
- Manage key partners and co-branded initiatives, coordinating with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and tracking.

Your Path

- 7+ years of experience in a similar role.
- Practical experience with analytics and server tools such as GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager and their relevant reporting frameworks.
- Provenience to manage, mentor and update team members.
- Past experience in the strategy and execution of the lead generation is a strong plus.
- Solid experience in budget ownership and cost control.

Your Essential Elements

- English fluent (last languages are a plus).
- Solid analytical skills and the ability to use data to make informed decisions.
- Provenience to drive direct sales growth and improve ROAS through high-performance digital advertising campaigns.
- Passion for digital marketing, performance media and innovative digital solutions.
- Deep knowledge of Google and Meta advertising platforms, including configuration auditing, implementation and performance analysis with actionable insights.
- Excellent organizational skills, project management and troubleshooting.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office and data display tools such as Datorama.
- Solid collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal teams and external partners.
- Ability to identify trends in data and transform insights into operational strategic recommendations.
- Autostarter with the ability to work independently and take the initiative.
- Safe communication of self and articulated, at ease in interacting with senior stakeholders and internal teams.
- Strong strategic thinking ability, able to act as a 'Loyal Council' for senior management.
- High attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast environment.
- Positive attitude, proactive mentality and the drive to embrace new challenges.
- Knowledge of affiliate platforms such as Awin, Kwanko and similar tools. Strong network of industry contacts to start opportunities for partnerships and partnerships of the brand.

Our Commitment

We are committed to building a future that enhances different perspectives, welcomes the world beyond borders and promotes an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be himself. Our commitment extends to taking measures that have a long-term positive impact on our guests, our employees and our planet.

Ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join MSC Cruises, where new opportunities await you. Apply today to be part of a global team that pushes limits and achieves exceptional results. Your journey begins here!

Mansioni

Il Senior Digital Acquisition Manager sarà responsabile della guida della strategia di marketing digitale su tutti i mercati MSC Cruises, con l'obiettivo di guidare le vendite dirette attraverso leve di pubblicità digitale, impostare e raggiungere gli obiettivi KPI e sviluppare campagne digitali innovative su più canali. Il candidato ideale avrà una solida esperienza nella pubblicità di prestazioni e nello sviluppo delle vendite digitali con un ROAS positivo, oltre a una forte esperienza nella strategia delle campagne di pubblicità digitale, nella pianificazione e implementazione dei media a pagamento e nella leadership del team. Inoltre, il ruolo comprenderà lo sviluppo di programmi di affiliazione e partnership come parte di una strategia di impegno digitale integrata per ampliare la portata, guidare il traffico qualificato e supportare il valore a lungo termine del cliente.

Il Tuo Impatto

- Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni solide con gli stakeholder di MSC in vari mercati, con una profonda comprensione delle loro esigenze aziendali, sfide e opportunità, bilanciando gli obiettivi globali stabiliti dalla sede centrale.
- Impostare e raggiungere gli obiettivi KPI per le vendite online attraverso leve di pubblicità digitale, assicurando che l'agenzia media consegni contro i target e gli obblighi contrattuali.
- Guidare le riunioni interne, le QBR e le revisioni annuali fornendo insight strategici e raccomandazioni basati sulle prestazioni della campagna, sulle analisi del sito web, sulle tendenze di mercato e sul panorama competitivo.
- Pianificare e implementare campagne di marketing delle prestazioni innovative su canali Paid Search, Display, Social, Native, Digital Audio e Video, personalizzate per gli obiettivi aziendali e le dinamiche di mercato.
- Collaborare con i team interni, tra cui Creativo, Social Media, Data & Analytics, SEO, Content, Product e gli agency partner, per garantire la consegna tempestiva di asset di alta qualità allineati con gli obiettivi di vendita digitale annuali.
- Identificare e inseguire opportunità per migliorare i flussi di entrate attraverso strategie digitali esistenti e nuove, migliorando il ROAS della campagna e sperimentando innovazioni nell'ecosistema adtech e martech.
- Sviluppare e gestire strategie di generazione di lead, assicurando che i flussi di acquisizione del cliente e le tattiche di nurturing siano in atto su tutti i punti di contatto dei media a pagamento.
- Monitorare il resourcing del conto e la redditività per garantire che i mercati locali e la sede centrale siano gestiti in modo efficiente e redditizio.
- Fare da punto di escalation principale per le preoccupazioni sollevate dai team interni o dagli stakeholder dei mercati locali.
- Continuare a rivedere e ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro operativi, proponendo e implementando miglioramenti dei processi dove rilevante.
- Collaborare con gli stakeholder dei paesi e della sede centrale per preparare e gestire il budget di marketing digitale annuale, allineato con gli obiettivi di fatturato B2C di MSC Cruises.
- Guidare e ottimizzare i programmi di affiliazione e partnership per guidare il traffico qualificato e le conversazioni, assicurando l'allineamento con la strategia di acquisizione digitale e gli obiettivi di prestazione.
- Gestire i partner chiave e le iniziative co-branded, coordinandosi con i team interni per garantire l'esecuzione e il tracciamento senza soluzione di continuità.

Il Tuo Percorso Finora

- 7+ anni di esperienza in un ruolo simile.
- Esperienza pratica con gli strumenti di analisi e ad server come GA4, Adobe Analytics, Campaign Manager e i loro framework di reporting pertinenti.
- Provenienza nell'gestire, mentorare e aggiornare i membri del team.
- Passata esperienza nella strategia e nell'esecuzione della generazione di lead è un forte plus.
- Solida esperienza nella proprietà del budget e nel controllo dei costi.

I Tuoi Elementi Essenziali

- Fluente in inglese (ulteriori lingue sono un plus).
- Solide competenze analitiche e la capacità di utilizzare i dati per prendere decisioni informate.
- Provenienza nel guidare la crescita delle vendite dirette e migliorare il ROAS attraverso campagne pubblicitarie digitali ad alte prestazioni.
- Passione per il marketing digitale, i media di prestazione e le soluzioni digitali innovative.
- Profonda conoscenza delle piattaforme pubblicitarie di Google e Meta, comprese l'auditing della configurazione, l'implementazione e l'analisi delle prestazioni con insight azionabili.

descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The F&B Service Manager is a strategic headquarters-based role responsible for providing leadership, oversight, and guidance for all Food & Beverage service operations across the fleet. This role ensures service excellence, consistency in guest experience, and alignment with corporate standards. Acting as the primary liaison between shipboard teams and corporate leadership, the Manager of F&B Service drives quality, innovation, compliance, and talent development across all F&B operations. This role reports directly to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Operations & Standards - Define, implement, and maintain fleet-wide F&B service standards and best practices. - Develop and oversee strategic initiatives to enhance guest experience and operational efficiency across all vessels. - Coordinate with shipboard teams to ensure compliance with corporate policies, procedures, and brand standards. - Conduct remote audits, operational reviews, and assessments to maintain service excellence. Guest Experience & Quality Assurance - Monitor guest satisfaction and F&B performance metrics, analyze trends, and recommend improvements. - Collaborate with culinary and beverage teams to innovate and elevate the onboard F&B offering. - Ensure alignment with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols through corporate-led programs. Training & Leadership Development - Design and oversee training programs for F&B teams to ensure consistency with the brand’s service philosophy. - Mentor and develop shipboard F&B leaders to support career progression and succession planning. Human Resources & Leadership Oversight - Collaborate with HR on performance reviews, promotions, rotations, and career pathing for F&B personnel. - Promote a high-performance culture rooted in recognition, development, and fairness. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Serve as the principal corporate liaison for all F&B service matters across the fleet. - Coordinate F&B equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile and analyze operational reports, voyage summaries, and performance metrics for corporate leadership. - Participate in key shipboard meetings remotely or in person as required. Financial Oversight - Support financial sustainability and profitability of F&B operations across the fleet. - Implement continuous improvement programs to achieve operational and financial targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory planning, and resource allocation in coordination with shipboard teams. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

We are seeking a high-caliber, dedicated PMO Lead / Senior Project Manager to oversee a strategic infrastructure investment project in the Caribbean, while establishing governance and execution discipline across current and future projects in the investment pipeline.
This role carries full accountability for project delivery, spanning finance, construction, commercial, operational, HR, regulatory, and stakeholder dimensions. The successful candidate will act as the single point of coordination and control between investors, contractors, operators, lenders, and government stakeholders.

Your Impact

• Establish and lead a Project Management System, including governance, reporting, controls, and KPIs.
• Drive end-to-end execution of major infrastructure projects, from development through construction and into operations.
• Oversees construction delivery and project financials, including budgets, cash flow, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, lender requirements, and reporting.
• Lead commercial and contract management, supplier, and concession PPP agreements.
• Ensure operational readiness and handover, including systems, staffing, and procedures.
• Coordinate HR and workforce planning, ensuring compliance with local labor laws and effective contractor management.
• Identify and manage project risks across technical, financial, regulatory, ESG, and political dimensions.
• Provide PMO oversight and execution support for additional projects in the development funnel.

Your Journey so far

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Business, or related field; Master’s degree preferred.
• 15+ years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or real asset projects.
• Demonstrated leadership of complex, capital-intensive projects with multiple stakeholders.
• Strong experience across construction, project finance, commercial contracts, and operations.
• Experience in emerging markets and/or the Caribbean region strongly preferred.
• PMP / PRINCE2 or equivalent certification preferred.

Your Essentials

• Hands-on, structured, and highly accountable
• Executive presence and credibility with senior stakeholders
• Comfortable working in complex, multi-jurisdictional environments
• Willing to travel and be on-site as required

descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments.

Your Impact

Financial Management & Reporting

- Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI

- Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI

- Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions

- Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies

New Investments & Business Evaluation

- Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities

Budgeting & Forecasting

- Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes

- Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets

- Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights

Cross-Functional Support

- Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments.

- Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications

- Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments

Process Improvement & Systems

- Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities

- Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed

- Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background

- 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments

- Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus

- Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting

- Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls

- Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset

- Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple stakeholders

- High attention to detail with the ability to see the big picture

- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

descriptionByLocale.en:
Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. Leveraging our parent company MSC Group’s hundreds of years of maritime expertise, our fleet of six luxury ships (four currently in the pipeline) are being built and designed in a totally different and unique way that will transform and redefine the cruise experience, creating a category of its own, appealing to the next generation of luxury travellers. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization. At Explora Journeys, we are redefining luxury ocean travel — where discovery, well-being, and a deep respect for the seas come together in harmony. We seek passionate professionals who share our vision of a more immersive, transformative way to discover the world’s most inspiring destinations by sea. Are you ready to turn your passion into something extraordinary? Join us at Explora Journeys, where an ocean of opportunities awaits. Your journey to the Ocean State of Mind starts here.
